title: QueueFailed
description: One paper the explain queue gave up on (one JSON object per line in state/queue-failed.jsonl). queue fail appends these; queue add and queue take skip their ids.

id.description: Stable paper id: arxiv-<id> or doi-<doi with every character outside a-z 0-9 . _ - replaced by ->, lowercase.

reason.description: Why the paper cannot be explained, in a short plain sentence.

at.description: UTC time the paper was given up on, RFC 3339.
